name: hcapp_markDownDownDone
description: Marks a DownDown charge as done (IsDone = 1, IsCancelled = 0 — the two flags are mutually exclusive, so marking done also un-cancels). Idempotent. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 57, @param NULL); permission gate HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageDownDowns' in @kennelId (feature 'Manage Down Downs', GM or RA by default — see /hc-authorizations). New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event — permission scope and part of the UPDATE WHERE. NULL or zero-UUID: errorCode 1234, errorType 2. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to; part of the UPDATE WHERE. NULL or zero-UUID: 1234/2. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to mark as done. NULL or zero-UUID: 1234/2. No row matching all three ids: 4041/3. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure, missing parameter (1234/2), not authorised (1337/3), not found (4041/3) or unhandled error (1933/5): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope.
Follows the ErrorEnvelope on every error path.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.DownDowns SET IsDone = 1, IsCancelled = 0, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() where id + EventId + KennelId match (lines 103-109); trgDownDownsActivityCount refreshes the run card's down-down count when IsCancelled changes
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on validation, not authorised, not found and unhandled errors

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are BIT NOT NULL; the project standard is SMALLINT. Dart callers must parse them as JSON booleans.
